items.question: Complète : Last year, Yasmine decided ___ a vegetarian.
items.explanation: Decide est suivi de to + base verbale : decided to become.

items.question: Comment dire « Mes parents veulent que je fasse des études de médecine » ?
options: My parents want that I study medicine.
My parents want me study medicine.
My parents want I study medicine.
My parents want me to study medicine.
items.explanation: Pour vouloir que quelqu'un fasse quelque chose : want + personne (me) + to + base verbale. Jamais want that.

items.question: Complète : Nathan promised ___ anyone about the surprise party.
items.explanation: Promise est suivi de to + base verbale. À la forme négative, not se place devant to : not to tell.

items.question: Complète : The teacher told us ___ our phones in our bags.
items.explanation: Tell someone to do something : told + personne (us) + to + base verbale.

items.question: Complète : My cousin offered ___ me to the airport.
items.explanation: Offer est suivi de to + base verbale : offered to drive.

items.question: Quelle phrase est correcte ?
options: She agreed to lend me her bike.
She agreed lending me her bike.
She agreed me to lend her bike.
She agreed lend me her bike.
items.explanation: Agree est suivi de to + base verbale : agreed to lend. On ne place pas de personne entre agree et to.

items.prompt: My sister is planning ___ a year in Australia. (spend)
items.explanation: Plan est suivi de to + base verbale : planning to spend. Plan on + -ing existe aussi.

items.prompt: My mum wants me ___ my room before dinner. (tidy)
items.explanation: Want + personne + to + base verbale : wants me to tidy.

items.prompt: He decided ___ social media for a month. (not / use)
items.explanation: Decide est suivi de to + base verbale. À la forme négative, not se place devant to : not to use.

items.prompt: The coach told the players ___ more water. (drink)
items.explanation: Tell + personne + to + base verbale : told the players to drink.

answers: I want you to listen to me.
items.explanation: Want + personne (you) + to + base verbale. On ne dit jamais want that you.

answers: She has decided to learn Korean.
items.translation: Elle a décidé d'apprendre le coréen.
items.explanation: Decide est suivi de to + base verbale : decided to learn.

answers: They promised to call us back.
items.translation: Ils ont promis de nous rappeler.
items.explanation: Promise est suivi de to + base verbale. Le pronom us se place entre call et back.
